calculation_convention.moving_averages: Simple moving average over daily closes: MA20, MA60, MA120.
calculation_convention.ema: EMA seed is first available close; smoothing alpha = 2 / (period + 1).
calculation_convention.macd: DIF = EMA12 - EMA26; DEA = EMA9(DIF); Histogram = DIF - DEA.
calculation_convention.rsi: Wilder RSI(14) using average gain/loss smoothing.
